subject: Request: Remedy authorization and evidence for 2026-11-15 throughput incident
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@novum.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Throughput degradation 2026-11-15 — request for remedy / next steps

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the incident report published yesterday. Novum saw sustained throughput degradation on 2026-11-15 between ~03:20–04:40 UTC for our production inference route (model: rdw-lab-v1). This impacted our batch scoring jobs and caused ~18% missed SLAs for that window.

Can you confirm Novum's eligibility for a service remedy under our contract? We need:
- Statement of affected window (UTC) and root-cause summary
- Per-customer uptime percentage used to calculate remedy amount
- The remedy calculation and proposed credit amount (invoice offset)
- Any evidence/logs you can share for our audit (requesting anonymized service logs for the affected route)

We'd like to get a proposed credit by Friday Nov 19 so our procurement team can sign off and apply the offset to the Dec invoice.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Best,
Sarah Patel
Director of Platform Ops
Novum.ai
Attachments: uptime-log-2026-11-15.csv (customer-side extracts of request timing)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@novum.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Throughput degradation 2026-11-15 — request for remedy / next steps

Hi Sarah — thank you for the clear note and for the attached CSV. We’ve opened an internal remediation workflow and I’ve looped in Marissa (sales ops) and Rishi (incident engineering).

What I can confirm now:
- Redwood logged increased queue times on the route you reference between 03:12–04:49 UTC on 2026-11-15 while a degraded network path and autoscaler race condition coincided.
- Our postmortem points to a kube autoscaler bug that delayed instance spin-up; root cause writeup is in progress.

Next steps from our side:
1) Rishi will provide the formal affected window and a token-level uptime % used for the remedy calc.
2) Marissa and I will draft an initial credit calculation and route it to finance (Laura) for approval.
3) We’ll produce redacted service logs and the internal incident timeline for you by EOD Wed (Nov 18).

If that timeline works, we aim to deliver a proposed credit by end-of-day Nov 19. If you need faster turnaround, please tell us what deadline is critical.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: none
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Throughput degradation 2026-11-15 — affected window and preliminary uptime

Folks — I pulled the route-level telemetry and KV cache traces. Findings (summary):
- Customer route rdw-lab-v1 experienced elevated 95th pct latency starting 2026-11-15 03:12:14 UTC, returning to baseline at 2026-11-15 04:49:02 UTC.
- During the window, effective request success rate dropped to 98.1% overall; after filtering retries from client-side batching, the per-token availability for Novum’s org was 97.8% (see attached extract).
- Based on our SLA appendix (annual baseline 99.5% availability for the route), the measured availability for affected window implies a remedial credit band.

I’m uploading logs to the share link and attaching the CSV extract we generated. Marissa/Laura — please use the per-token availability (97.8%) for a remediation calc; I’ll add the incident timeline and root-cause note to the postmortem later today.

— Rishi
Senior Incident Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: rdw-route-extract-20261115.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@novum.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:28:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed remedy amount and calculation — Novum.ai (incident 2026-11-15)

Hi Sarah — following Rishi’s telemetry we ran the credit calculation per the SLA formula. Summary: 
- SLA baseline availability: 99.5%
- Measured availability during affected window: 97.8% (per-token, customer-scoped)
- Duration: 01:36:48 (03:12:14–04:49:02 UTC)

Per the contract remedy table, the shortfall (1.7 percentage points) falls into the 1–3% bracket, corresponding to a 10% invoice credit for the billing period covering the affected usage.
Proposed credit: 10% of the monthly invoice line-items tied to inference consumption for Nov 2026. We’ve calculated this as $14,200 USD based on Novum’s usage profile (see attached credit-calculation-novum-v1.xlsx).

Laura — can you confirm approval for issuing an invoice offset for this amount and advise estimated posting date?

Sarah — if you confirm acceptance of the calc, we can prepare a signed remedy acknowledgement and post the credit to your Dec invoice. If you prefer a different mechanism (one-time refund, account credit, or pro-rated next invoice), flag preferred option and we’ll route accordingly.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: credit-calculation-novum-v1.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@novum.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:37:00 -0800
Subject: Remedy approval and issuance schedule — Novum.ai incident 2026-11-15

Marissa / Sergio / Rishi / Sarah —

Finance has reviewed the calculation and approved an invoice offset in the amount of $14,200 USD as a remedy for the Nov 15 incident. Authorization details:
- Approval code: RB-FIN-2026-1108-NVA
- Mechanism: invoice credit to be applied to Novum.ai’s Dec 1, 2026 invoice (preferred by customer).
- Posting ETA: credit will be reflected on the next invoice; accounting will send confirmation and ledger entry by Nov 24.

Sarah — attached is a short remedy acknowledgement PDF we ask you to sign to confirm acceptance of the credit and close the claim. Once signed, we’ll schedule the adjustment and share the accounting confirmation. If Novum prefers a one-time wire instead, please indicate and we’ll route for payment instead of invoice offset.

Apologies again for the disruption — Rishi’s postmortem will be published to the incident page this afternoon and Sergio will follow up on any open questions around mitigation and autoscaler changes.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations (Finance), Redwood Inference
Attachments: signed-remedy-ack-20261119.pdf (please return signed copy)
